name: (A) Techie in Love byte: Dominic
source:
After a particularly strenuous year and day, childhood friends Dominic and Cecilia find themselves trying to gather their bearings during an afternoon lunch.

[From [url=https://sagemintiart.itch.io/a-techie-in-love-byte-dominic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在经历了格外煎熬的一年与疲惫不堪的一天之后，青梅竹马的多米尼克与塞西莉亚趁着午后共进午餐的工夫，努力整理着各自纷乱的心绪。

[摘自[url=https://sagemintiart.itch.io/a-techie-in-love-byte-dominic]itch.io[/url]]
